name: Curicó Valley
shape: Chile Decreto 464, drawn from its comunas and provinces

notes: The Andes and Coastal Range trap warm, dry air here, while cool Andes nights keep acidity high alongside ripe fruit.

blurb.text: A Chilean subregion of the Central Valley, the main growing zone for Chilean wine, that contains the Teno and Lontué Valleys.
